name: Heavyweight Heads | Wet P
description: Wet Paint is a pheno of the well-known gorilla glue strain, that draws most of its traits from the chocolate diesel parent. These dense buds have a diesel aroma, with flavors of chem and bubblegum. This indica-leaning hybrid will soon be a favorite.
